questions.q: Two angles on a straight line measure $3x$ and $2x+30$. Find $x$.
questions.answer: Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$: $3x+2x+30=180\Rightarrow5x=150\Rightarrow x=30$.

questions.q: Find the angle vertically opposite a $65^{\circ}$ angle.
questions.answer: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the angle is $65^{\circ}$.

questions.q: Three angles around a point measure $110^{\circ}$, $95^{\circ}$, and $x$. Find $x$.
questions.answer: Angles around a point sum to $360^{\circ}$: $x=360-110-95=155^{\circ}$.

questions.q: Two angles are complementary (sum to $90^{\circ}$). One measures $37^{\circ}$. Find the other.
Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, creating an angle of $70^{\circ}$. Find its corresponding angle.
questions.answer: Corresponding angles are equal, so the angle is $70^{\circ}$.
